# 2 Chronicles Chapter 36 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** And-they-took people-of the-land Jehoahaz son-of Josiah and-they-made-him-king in-place-of his-father in-Jerusalem.

**2** Son-of twenty-and-three years was-Jehoahaz in-his-reigning and-three months he-reigned in-Jerusalem.

**3** And-he-removed-him king-of Egypt in-Jerusalem and-he-fined the-land a-hundred talents-of silver and-a-talent-of gold.

**4** And-he-made-king king-of Egypt Eliakim his-brother over Judah and-Jerusalem and-he-changed his-name to-Jehoiakim and-Jehoahaz his-brother took Neco and-he-brought-him to-Egypt.

**5** Son-of twenty-and-five years was-Jehoiakim in-his-reigning and-eleven years he-reigned in-Jerusalem and-he-did the-evil in-eyes-of YHWH his-God.

**6** Against-him came-up Nebuchadnezzar king-of Babylon and-he-bound-him in-bronze-chains to-bring-him to-Babylon.

**7** And-from-vessels-of house-of YHWH brought Nebuchadnezzar to-Babylon and-he-put-them in-his-temple in-Babylon.

**8** And-rest-of acts-of Jehoiakim and-his-abominations that he-did and-the-found against-him behold-them written on book-of kings-of Israel and-Judah and-he-reigned Jehoiachin his-son in-his-place.

**9** Son-of eight years was-Jehoiachin in-his-reigning and-three months and-ten days he-reigned in-Jerusalem and-he-did the-evil in-eyes-of YHWH.

**10** And-at-return-of the-year sent the-king Nebuchadnezzar and-he-brought-him to-Babylon with-vessels-of desire-of house-of YHWH and-he-made-king Zedekiah his-brother over Judah and-Jerusalem.

**11** Son-of twenty-and-one years was-Zedekiah in-his-reigning and-eleven years he-reigned in-Jerusalem.

**12** And-he-did the-evil in-eyes-of YHWH his-God not he-humbled-himself before Jeremiah the-prophet from-mouth-of YHWH.

**13** And-also against-the-king Nebuchadnezzar he-rebelled who made-him-swear by-God and-he-stiffened his-neck and-he-hardened his-heart from-returning to YHWH God-of Israel.

**14** Also all leaders-of the-priests and-the-people multiplied unfaithfulness according-to-all abominations-of the-nations and-they-defiled house-of YHWH that He-consecrated in-Jerusalem.

**15** And-He-sent YHWH God-of their-fathers upon-them by-hand-of His-messengers rising-early and-sending for He-had-compassion on His-people and-on His-dwelling.

**16** And-they-were mocking at-messengers-of God and-despising His-words and-scoffing at-His-prophets until went-up wrath-of YHWH against-His-people until there-was-no remedy.

**17** And-He-brought-up against-them king-of the-Chaldeans and-he-killed their-young-men with-the-sword in-house-of their-sanctuary and-not he-had-compassion on young-man or virgin old-man or aged He-gave all in-his-hand.

**18** And-all vessels-of house-of God the-great and-the-small and-treasures-of house-of YHWH and-treasures-of the-king and-his-princes all he-brought to-Babylon.

**19** And-they-burned house-of God and-they-tore-down wall-of Jerusalem and-all its-palaces they-burned with-fire and-all its-vessels-of desire for-destruction.

**20** And-he-exiled the-remaining from the-sword to-Babylon and-they-were to-him and-to-his-sons for-servants until reign-of kingdom-of Persia

**21** to-fulfill word-of YHWH by-mouth-of Jeremiah until enjoyed the-land its-sabbaths all days-of the-desolation it-rested to-fulfill seventy years.

**22** And-in-year one of-Cyrus king-of Persia to-complete word-of YHWH by-mouth-of Jeremiah He-stirred-up YHWH spirit-of Cyrus king-of Persia and-he-caused-to-pass a-proclamation in-all his-kingdom and-also in-writing saying

**23** Thus says Cyrus king-of Persia all kingdoms-of the-earth gave to-me YHWH God-of the-heavens and-He He-appointed-me to-build for-Him a-house in-Jerusalem that is-in-Judah who among-you from-all His-people YHWH his-God be-with-him and-let-him-go-up.


---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **36:15-16**: rising-early and-sending...mocking...despising...scoffing — God's persistent compassion meets persistent rejection. The escalating verbs (mock, despise, scoff) mirror the escalating refusal.

- **36:21**: until enjoyed the-land its-sabbaths — The exile is framed as Sabbath rest for the land, connecting the punishment to the Levitical legislation (Lev 25-26). The land gets what Israel denied it.

- **36:22-23**: let-him-go-up — The book ends with permission to return. The last word of Chronicles is ve-ya'al (and let him go up). The story is not over.


— EMET
